description.text: This major can be taught in English, and the tuition will be RMB 40,000 per year.

duration.text: The Technological Economy and Management at Dalian University of Technology is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese/English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4583 USD/per year ￥ 33000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 5 or above 6. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: 1. Hold a master's degree 2. Be in good health 3. Under the age of 45 4. Recommendation of two professors (full or associate) 5. Pass entrance examination. 6. A Chinese level of HSK 5 or above, there are no HSK requirements for those who applied for courses taught in English.
